author: Amine7777777
quote:
Overrated game. Too expensive for what it offers, too many bugs, barely runs at 30 FPS, and the gameplay is limited and slow.
I can’t feel the GTA identity. The chaos and balls that GTA used to have are gone. Instead, we got **** realism that ruins all the fun. It looks like a reskin of RDR2 with cars instead of horses. Nothing innovative or “wow.” The story is boring and uninteresting, the protagonists are bad, and there are way too many naked people for no reason and too much unnecessary lust.
I could go on like this all day. This is a flop, and when I see a 99 score, I lose faith in reviewers.
Sadly the downfall of Rockstar has begun.
